T_HEAD_D_HEAD_A_measured_m.description: Kalibr T_cn_cnm1; maps HEAD_A optical coordinates into HEAD_D optical coordinates

measured_head_position_refinement.rotation_policy: Ignore the measured optical-frame rotation when defining the head-rigid extrinsic. Both cameras retain the user-confirmed theoretical R_rigid_camera exactly.
measured_head_position_refinement.position_alignment_method: Preserve the theoretical stereo midpoint in head-rigid coordinates and apply half of the measured-minus-theoretical baseline difference symmetrically along the theoretical baseline axis.
measured_head_position_refinement.usage_note: The cameras section contains theory plus the measured position offsets. Rotation is always the theoretical shared_rotation. The raw Kalibr matrix is retained only as source evidence and must not replace R_rigid_camera.

assumptions: The supplied dx/dy/dz values locate each camera optical center in head-rigid coordinates.
Left and right cameras have the same stated axis orientation relative to the head rigid body.
The 174.0 mm stereo baseline is derived from the supplied y offsets and is not an independent stereo-calibration result.
The latest measured head stereo pair is stored as CAM_A/C; CAM_C is mapped to the physical HEAD_D used in this recording.
The head-rigid rotation is theoretical and fixed; the measured stereo calibration contributes only a symmetric optical-center position offset.
Because stereo calibration alone does not locate the pair midpoint relative to CH07, the theoretical midpoint is preserved.
